```yaml
name: Check Discord Link Health

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */12 * * *'  # Every 12 hours
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-discord-link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Extract Discord invite code from README.md
        id: extract_readme
        run: |
          INVITE_CODE=$(grep -o 'discord\.gg/[a-zA-Z0-9]\+' README.md | head -1 | cut -d'/' -f3)
          echo "invite_code=$INVITE_CODE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Extract Discord invite code from src/render-table.js
        id: extract_render_table
        run: |
          INVITE_CODE=$(grep -o 'discord\.gg/[a-zA-Z0-9]\+' src/render-table.js | head -1 | cut -d'/' -f3)
          echo "invite_code=$INVITE_CODE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Validate Discord invite link
        id: validate_link
        run: |
          INVITE_CODE=${{ steps.extract_readme.outputs.invite_code }}
          if [ -z "$INVITE_CODE" ]; then
            echo "Failed to extract invite code from README.md"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o response.json "https://discord.com/api/v10/invites/$INVITE_CODE")
          
          if [ "$RESPONSE" -eq 200 ]; then
            echo "link_valid=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Link is valid"
          else
            echo "link_valid=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Link returned HTTP status: $RESPONSE"
          fi

      - name: Check for existing open issue
        id: check_issue
        if: steps.validate_link.outputs.link_valid == 'false'
        run: |
          ISSUE_EXISTS=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues?state=open&labels=discord-link" | \
            jq -r '.[] | select(.title | contains("Discord link")) | .number' | head -1)
          
          if [ -n "$ISSUE_EXISTS" ]; then
            echo "existing_issue=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Existing issue found: #$ISSUE_EXISTS"
          else
            echo "existing_issue=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "No existing issue found"
          fi

      - name: Create issue if link is invalid and no existing issue
        if: steps.validate_link.outputs.link_valid == 'false' && steps.check_issue.outputs.existing_issue == 'false'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { data: issue } = await github.rest.issues.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: 'Invalid Discord invite link',
              body: 'The Discord invite link `discord.gg/${{ steps.extract_readme.outputs.invite_code }}` is invalid or expired. Please update it to the new working link.',
              labels: ['discord-link']
            });
            
            console.log(`Created issue #${issue.number}: ${issue.title}`);
```
